name: Minnow run
text: A school of minnows passes by. Bites come quicker for a little while.

name: Bright moon
text: The moon comes out bright. Rarer fish rise to see it.

name: Golden hour
text: Golden light on the water. Fish sell for a little more.

name: Lantern drift
text: Paper lanterns drift over from the village. Fish come up a little bigger.
